thread:
ashley: Quick check — PR #8342 (model-routing perf) is passing unit and integration on my machine but is stuck in the e2e queue (job e2e/large). Can someone backfill or advise on a staggered merge plan? I'm targeting this for today's rolling deploy.
ci-bot: Job e2e/large queued (position 5). Estimated start: ~22m. Triggered by PR 8342.
pavan: Position 5 is rough. Do we have any smaller PRs to land first to avoid the full queue spike? :thinking: 
leo: I can merge #8350 (small docs fix) after it's approved. That should clear one slot. @anita can you approve when you have 2 mins?
anita: On it. Quick skim — looks safe. Approving now :thumbsup: 
ashley: thanks! Also idea: can we backfill an e2e worker on the dedicated pool? I can run a backfill command if someone gives greenlight.
marco: We have a spare GPU in staging but not in prod. If we backfill, remember the deploy freeze window starts at 18:00 UTC for the release cut. Deploy-bot: Reminder — deploy freeze in effect 2026-03-17 18:00-20:00 UTC. No merges to main after freeze unless emergency.
ashley: Ack. Then we should aim to land before 17:45 UTC or postpone until after the freeze. If queue time >20m we should postpone.
pavan: Alternative: staggered merge — merge low-risk PRs every 10 mins instead of one big batch. That keeps queue steady. Who's owning the schedule?
leo: I'll coordinate merges from this thread. Plan: merge #8350 (docs), wait 10m, then re-run e2e for #8342. If flake persists, revert plan and put PR on hold.
ashley: I'll rebase #8342 onto latest main now and push — should reduce CI churn. Command I'm about to run:
```
git checkout 8342 && git fetch origin main && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease
```
anita: After the rebase I'll trigger a manual e2e backfill: `cictl backfill --job e2e/large --pr 8342` — give me the go.
ci-bot: Manual backfill scheduled for PR 8342 by anita. Backfill will run when an executor becomes available.
marco: One more ask — if the e2e hits the same flake, please paste the failing stacktrace here and tag me. I can try a quick test isolation patch.
ashley: Will do. If all goes well, expect merge by ~17:40 UTC. If not, we'll defer until after the freeze. Thanks everyone :pray:
